confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chilean and northern coastal Chilean price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately grounded. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain and may vary with July winter-holiday demand. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price relationship (cocktail and wine priced as multiples of the beer anchor), not from direct venue data. FX provenance: the 0.6947 USD per AUD observation for 2026-10-16 came from a third-party page that attributes it to the RBA. I did not confirm it on rba.gov.au, where my search showed only a March 2026 snapshot, so it should be verified against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other northern Chilean coastal cities with similar tourism and price levels (such as Arica and Antofagasta), adjusted for Iquique's modest free-zone retail economy and its beach-resort tourist segment. Restaurant and drink prices are placed between Santiago's mid-range and smaller regional Chilean cities.
